name: Scaffold
goal: A runnable empty solution with all quality gates and a test harness for unit and protocol tests.
scope: Solution with the projects from CLAUDE.md, central package management, global.json
Architecture tests (dependency directions, no MCP SDK in the business logic)
CI (GitHub Actions): build without warnings, tests, format – Linux, macOS, Windows
Test harness: FakeTimeProvider for unit tests, MCP client for protocol tests against the built server
parity: Architecture tests green; the harness starts an empty server and reads the tool list

name: Server core & protocol
goal: The server speaks both protocol generations and lists both tools with schemas and annotations.
scope: Host with stdio transport, stdout only for JSON-RPC, logs to stderr
Both tools registered with own descriptions, input and output schema, annotations; bodies without logic for now
Unknown tool as JSON-RPC -32602, unknown arguments ignored
Server name and version, no prompts/resources
parity: I-INIT-1, I-INIT-2, I-LIST-1..5, I-LIST-7, I-ERR-1, I-ERR-2, I-ERR-4, I-LOG-1

name: Time zones & current time
goal: get_current_time returns the correct time for every valid IANA zone and clearly rejects everything else.
scope: TimeZoneName: exact IANA keys, equally strict on all platforms, paths rejected
TimeResult: ISO 8601 with offset, English weekday, daylight saving flag
Result shape: structuredContent plus JSON text block
Business errors as isError with clear information
parity: B-NOW-1..15, B-ERR-1..5, I-RES-1, I-ERR-3, I-ERR-4 (isError false)

name: Conversion
goal: convert_time converts wall-clock times correctly across daylight saving time, quarter-hour offsets, and date boundaries – with an optional date.
scope: Time format H:M to HH:MM, reference date today in the source zone or optional date
Skipped wall-clock time as an error, ambiguous wall-clock time as the first occurrence
Time difference at the converted moment in the format +1.0h / +5.75h
Extend the input schema with an optional date

name: Start, local time zone & distribution
goal: The server starts with the detected or overridden local time zone and can be installed as decided in research.md.
scope: --local-timezone checked before the transport, one line on stderr on error
Detect the system zone, fall back to UTC; local zone in the parameter descriptions
--help, unknown options
Packaging and delivery as in research.md, smoke test in CI
